text_block_list.text: ...Daiwa Scarlet keeps staring off into the distance.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Eek!? Wh-What is it?!
You startled me, talking to me all of a sudden like that!?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Is it time for training already?
Hmph, no problem! I'm fully prepared to run!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I-I just misspoke, that's all!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I was planning on dedicating
today to race research!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Umm, where's the TV remote?
Oh, never mind. I'll just turn it on by hand—

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text:
“—Now, watched over by clear and refreshing skies,
the Umamusume racing in the Nippon Derby are...”

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text: (――*snap*)

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Because, it's just weird, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
What part of that is "cool"?
If you're aiming to be cool, act with some integrity.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Even though you ran in the Oka Sho, you went and changed routes.
Doing everything half-assed is just completely uncool!"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: And yet...
choice_data_list: Why did they enter the Derby, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...I don't know! I have no idea!
I'm the one who wants to ask that!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"H-Hold on, Trainer.
Where do you think you're going?!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAAAHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Man, talk about a sudden change of course.
How many years has it been since someone like that showed up?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I wanted to see her in the Oaks.
Taking the classic royal road just like Scarlet.
...Vodka, crowned as the queen."

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
No, no, it's precisely because it's not conventional
that makes it interesting, right?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Not at all. To me, it just looks like
you ran away from the Tiara showdown.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...In the end, people are talking all sorts of smack about you.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, passing the Great Keyaki Tree, the lead pack
heads into the final straight! Who will make their move?!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And here comes Vodka, splitting the pack and bursting forward!
—But is she struggling?! She hasn't reached the leader just yet!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
See, just as I thought. Vodka
should have run the Oaks, not the Derby.

...Amidst a chorus of voices,
Vodka keeps on running.

"Just looking straight ahead.
Shaking everything off, carving my own path."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...What is it?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"...What on earth are you doing?!
Don't you dare go losing in a place like this!"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Show me your path, then!
If you're really gonna run in a way that's so true to yourself!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Then prove to me you weren't running away from meee!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"...No, here comes Vodka! Vodka is charging forward!
She's tearing up the slope with an overwhelming burst of speed!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"First place in the Japanese Derby goes to Vodka!
She brilliantly passes the other Umamusume and crosses the finish line!!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text: (Wooooaaaaah-------!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
See, wasn't that awesome?!
Vodka's running!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
......Yes.
It was so cool, I got all excited.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
...This race, it might
stay in my memory forever, maybe.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...An unforgettable race.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...It is what it is.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
All she did was run in this Derby.
Just that... and yet, why...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I can't get the way she ran out of my head.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
The sight of her taking 1st place...
it's burned into my mind forever...!
choice_data_list: It's because she was “so cool,” you know.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...What do you mean, 'cool'?
I don't get it at all.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...None of this should make any sense!
And yet... ngh...!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I can't leave things like this!
I want to beat her!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"I want to beat her... the one
who took away the '#1' spot I wanted...!"

Daiwa Scarlet's eyes
sparkled with a fiery brilliance.

She might not see the final destination of the "Number One" she aims for just yet.
Even so—

I feel like I've found a clue in searching for that answer.
Next stop: the Shuka Sho.
The final leg of the Triple Tiara.
